Priya Nair: Quick check 11 1 I'm arranging sibling-care for the first two weeks after my return (50% phased). Is that covered by the family benefits subsidy?

Dana (People Ops): Hi Priya 1 yes, sibling-care (short-term) is eligible when tied to a phased return or parental leave transition. Its prorated by FTE. Please upload invoice + payment proof + manager confirmation.

Priya Nair: Great. Ill upload. Can it be backdated to cover the first week I already paid out of pocket?

Zoe (Manager): I can confirm Priya had an approved 50% phased return starting 2026-07-05. Will attach a short note.

Benefits Bot: Retroactive requests: up to 60 days retro without exec sign-off. Include reason for retro request in the portal case. Tag "sibling-care". Non-US employees: indicate country for tax handling.

Priya Nair: Invoice snippet: Vendor: Little Hands Care; Dates: 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-16; Amount: $320; Payment: card 07/06 ref ABC. Uploaded as case FB-3319.

Luis (Payroll): Case FB-3319 received. Note: reimbursement code FAMILYCR. If you want split payments say so in the case. International flag set to US. Expect payment next regular payroll unless off-cycle requested.

Dana (People Ops): Thanks all 1 Dana will review and confirm within 2 business days.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick responses :pray:
